meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能借助 `dial` 命令发送短信、拨打 AI 语音电话、购买/设置号码，并等待入站短信或通话事件；它会先查看帮助与文档，再按要求使用必需参数。
howto.when: 当用户提到电话、短信、验证码等，或要求拨打电话、发短信、等待验证码时触发；会话中首次使用 `dial` 命令前也会加载。

say.note: 会执行 `dial message` 发送短信。

say.text: 给 +14155550123 打电话，让 AI 帮忙问一下订单号。
say.note: 会执行 `dial call` 发起 AI 语音通话。

say.text: 等有短信发到我的号码，把验证码告诉我。
say.note: 会运行 `dial wait-for` 并解析内容。

howto.what_en: The skill lets Claude drive the `dial` CLI: send SMS, place AI voice calls, buy or update numbers, and wait for inbound SMS/events. It checks `--help` and docs first and follows the required parameter conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions phones, SMS, or verification codes, asks to call/send/receive a code, or before the first `dial` command in a session.

say_en.text: Send a text to +14155550123 saying "See you tomorrow".
say_en.note: Runs `dial message` to send the SMS.

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and have the AI ask for their order number.
Wait for an SMS to my number and tell me the verification code.
